Name: Ziza, Son of Shiphi
Summary: Son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah, prince of Simeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:37: Son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah, prince of Simeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ziza stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
